picks.file: VUE DE KOUTAIS, ancienne capitale de l'Iméréthie, sur la rivière Rion.jpg
picks.what: The city along the Rioni River, photograph in Gustave Schlumberger, L’Épopée byzantine
picks.why: true general view: both banks of the Rioni, the bridge, and the Bagrati ruins on the hill at right; caption trimmed off

picks.what: The Meskhishvili Drama Theater on the central square, photograph
picks.why: color view of the city’s main square and its landmark theater

gaps: P0–P3: nothing usable (a coin only); P6: kept the existing 2025 view
notes: Date for #7: Commons says 1905–25, but the caption names Schlumberger’s L’Épopée byzantine, part 2 (Basile II), published in 1900, so the photo is from the 1890s at the latest; labeled “about 1900”. The 1888 Library of Congress photo (#2) shows Gelati Monastery, about 11 km outside the city, so it was skipped. The 1934–35 “Kutais” photos are of a ship.
